sequence_points.name: Abstract Sculptural Form in White
sequence_points.description: A large-scale abstract artwork featuring undulating white forms with pleated textures, resembling folded paper or fabric, mounted on a wall. The composition uses light and shadow to emphasize depth and curvature against a neutral background.

sequence_points.name: Yellow Horse in Arched Niche
sequence_points.description: A painting depicting a bright yellow horse standing within an arched architectural niche. The composition features warm tones and a minimalist background, emphasizing the horse as the central subject.
